backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, fasting schedules, and nutrition tracking with role-based access control using Principal-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: updating heading colors from green to logo-inspired golden/amber tones and adjusting FactorMarker card colors to harmonize with the DNA helix background.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing the LivSpan health tracking application with DNA helix theming, internationalization (EN/DE), fasting tracking, nutrition panels, and authentication flows.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes with custom CSS layers for base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with forced dark mode class and inline script to prevent light mode flash on initial page load.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing theme, language, authentication state, and displaying a loading screen with LivSpan logo during initialization before rendering the main dashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and internationalized labels.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive health factor card component with hover effects, selection states, and visual connection to the DNA helix using golden/amber accent colors.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: Settings panel for configuring intermittent fasting schedules with hour selectors, protocol display (e.g., 16:8), and save/cancel functionality with backend persistence.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel displaying intermittent fasting status, timer, progress, and metrics (daily/weekly summaries, streak). Includes fasting schedule settings for authenticated users and calculates protocol labels based on fasting/eating windows.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking nutrition metrics including body weight, protein intake, and vegetable consumption. Calculates BMI and protein targets, displays progress bars, and allows authenticated users to save daily nutrition entries.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA double helix background with gradients, glow filters, and connecting base pairs. Uses CSS animations for breathing, pulsing, and glowing effects with motion-safe/reduce support.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Container component rendering a vertical DNA helix spine with two animated strands and connecting base pairs. Provides a central axis and evenly distributed markers for child content.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Button component for toggling between English and German languages, displaying current selection with accent color and using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that prompts unauthenticated users to login and requires authenticated users to complete profile onboarding (name, birth year, height, gender) before accessing child content. Includes form validation and DNA helix background.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralized constant definitions for React Query cache keys including user profile, fasting schedule, and nutrition queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes and initializes access control with admin token.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the user's fasting schedule (start/end hours) with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Hook that calculates real-time fasting/eating phase, elapsed/remaining time, and progress percentage based on a schedule, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry (NutritionDay) with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profile data with actor-dependent loading to prevent UI flash during initialization.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Context provider for language selection (en/de) with localStorage persistence and browser language detection.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: TypeScript definitions and translation dictionaries for English and German UI strings across all app features.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Hook to access the language context (current language, setLanguage, and translations).
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system for light/dark modes, custom logo-inspired golden/amber palette, and sage/earth tones.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Demo helper functions returning mock daily/weekly fasting summaries (sessions, hours) and streak data for display purposes.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and safe number parsing with null handling.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro distribution (protein, fat, carbs, calories) and returns deterministic guidance keys for i18n lookup based on nutritional balance patterns.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utilities for formatting durations as HH:MM:SS and hours with decimal places for timer and KPI displays.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with DNA helix background, factor selection (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting), and expandable panels for each health factor.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (helix, sage palette), animations (breathe, pulse, glow), fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), and theme extensions.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural notes, features, and pending requests to change heading colors to match logo and adjust tile colors for background harmony.
